description:
Returns one account you provisioned, with the same shape the list returns: its lifecycle `status`, the `access_level` you hold, the state of its claim link and its `company_id` when the account holds exactly one company.

Endpoint: GET /v1/accounts/{account_id}

account_id.description: Identifier (UUID) of an account you provisioned. An account you did not provision answers exactly like one that does not exist, so its existence is never disclosed.

name: beel_get_account
